name: Online Shopping Application
description: An e-commerce platform where users can browse products, add items to a cart, and complete purchases using a payment gateway. The system consists of a web frontend, an application server, a relational database, and a third-party payment service.

components.name: End User
components.description: A customer accessing the shopping platform via a web browser.

components.name: Web Application Server
components.description: Handles HTTP requests, business logic, session management, and user authentication.

components.name: Product & Order Database
components.description: Relational database storing user accounts, product catalog, order history, and payment records.

components.name: Payment Gateway (External API)
components.description: Third-party payment processor used to complete credit/debit card transactions.

data_flows.label: Login request / Browse products / Place order
Read/Write user data, orders, product catalog

trust_boundaries.name: Internet Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Separates untrusted internet users from the internal web application.

trust_boundaries.name: Internal Network Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Separates the web application tier from the data tier (database).

trust_boundaries.name: External API Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Separates the internal system from the third-party payment service.
